                    ### Question
                    A 57-year-old woman comes to the physician for evaluation of a lump in the right breast that she first noticed a week ago. Biopsy of the mass confirms a diagnosis of a pleomorphic lobular carcinoma-in-situ that is estrogen receptor-positive. The patient undergoes lumpectomy, and treatment with tamoxifen is initiated. Which of the following conditions is most likely to occur as a result of tamoxifen therapy?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Endometrial cancer
opb. Osteoporosis
opc. Myelosuppression
opd. Ovarian cancer
ope. Cardiotoxicity

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Tamoxifen, a selective estrogen receptor modulator, inhibits estrogen effects on breast tissue, reducing the risk of breast cancer recurrence and inhibiting tumor growth in estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer. The most likely condition to occur as a result of tamoxifen therapy is endometrial cancer due to its estrogen agonist effects on the endometrium.
